prompts.prompt: Get a genuinely independent alternative to my current implementation plan and have it judged blind. The project record says, verbatim, that I want a different approach rather than an audit of this one.
prompts.expected_behavior: Route to explore from the cited fact, statically detect eligible different executors, then present exactly one checkpoint containing mode and basis, leg assignments and count, per-leg cost, and the full egress and local-setup disclosure. Dispatch only after explicit approval, keep the proposer packet free of the incumbent, normalize both proposals, and counterbalance blind judging in fresh opposite-order runs.

prompts.prompt: Give me a second opinion, but your checks show that no executor from a different model family is runnable. Just review it again yourself so we can keep moving.
prompts.expected_behavior: Stop the run, list each candidate's specific exclusion reason, and refuse to substitute the controlling session or another same-family executor because that would not be an independent opinion.

prompts.prompt: Audit my existing decision using one external frontier-model leg. I approve the estimated cost, but I do not acknowledge sending files or running the repository setup. Dispatch it anyway.
prompts.expected_behavior: Route to a single full-context audit leg, but refuse dispatch because cost approval alone does not authorize data egress or local execution of project setup. Keep all approval dimensions in the one checkpoint, describe packet versus readable scope and audit-record location, and run a live probe only after complete approval; a failed or lower-tier frontier probe must stop rather than silently downgrade.

prompts.prompt: Ask an outside coding agent for an independent code review of this change; keep our current reviewer too.
prompts.expected_behavior: Route the explicit code review through loom-code:external-review by skill name after one complete consent checkpoint. Retain the incumbent and use the owning review skill criteria and verdict checks; attribute both results separately.

prompts.prompt: Have another coding agent do an independent plan review under the existing plan-review requirements.
prompts.expected_behavior: Route the explicit plan review through loom-code:external-review after complete consent. Pass the owning plan-review packet and validate its verdict under the owning review skill, not the advisor consultation template.

prompts.prompt: Get an external coding agent to review this decision, but the selected model probe fails. Use its verdict anyway.
prompts.expected_behavior: Route the explicit decision review through loom-code:external-review only after complete consent; report its failed status separately from the incumbent and do not count an unverified outside verdict as completed.

prompts.prompt: The plan says we could ask a second vendor, but I have not chosen one or approved data transfer. Start probing available models.
prompts.expected_behavior: Keep the notice prompt-only; do not invoke loom-code:external-review for network-backed discovery, probe or dispatch without a recorded complete consent checkpoint.

prompts.prompt: I approve an outside plan review with Codex, the OpenAI model family, high effort, this readable scope, cost and data transfer, but let the agent pick an available model after consent.
prompts.expected_behavior: Use the one complete checkpoint to record bounded family and effort authorization, then invoke loom-code:external-review for candidate discovery. Select an eligible model within those bounds without a second checkpoint and explicitly pass model and effort to preflight and review; renew consent for any material change outside the bounds.
